description:
Use for ANY question about ISO 20022 external code sets: the values of a code set (BalanceType,
ReturnReason, Purpose, StatusReason, ...), what a code means (CLBD, OTHR, ...), whether a code is
valid in a code set, which code sets a message uses (camt.053, pain.001, ...), or which messages
use a code set. Call it even when the answer seems well known: it returns the sourced, current
values with their official descriptions and flags deactivated ones.

Send one identifier in `message`:
- A code set (BalanceType, or ExternalBalanceType1Code): its description, its values (code, name,
  description) and the messages that use it. Add `code` to check a single value.
- A code (CLBD): every code set that contains it, with the name and description in each.
- An ISO 20022 message (camt.053): the code sets it uses, with their number of values.

The values, code sets and matches are pipe-delimited text with a header row. Long lists are paged
by whole rows: when `page.complete` is false, call again with the same input and the offset in
`page.next_offset` until it is true, before answering about the whole list.

Not covered: Bank Transaction Codes (PMNT, PMNT-RCDT-ESCT; use iso20022_bank_transaction_codes),
which ISO 20022 message replaces a legacy message or which schemes use one (use
iso20022_legacy_and_scheme_mappings), and what a message itself contains. Code set usage is
message-level, not element-level. The code set description (concept_description) is AI-generated.

code.description: Optional, only when message is a code set: check one code in that set, e.g. message 'BalanceType' with code 'CLBD'. Returns just that value, so use it for 'is X a valid ...' questions instead of fetching the whole set.
code.title: Code

message.description: A code set (e.g. 'BalanceType', or its full name 'ExternalBalanceType1Code'), a code (e.g. 'CLBD', 'OTHR'), or an ISO 20022 message (e.g. 'camt.053', 'pacs.008.001.08').
message.title: Message

offset.description: Row to start from; 0 (the default) is the first row. Use only to continue a list whose previous response said it was not complete, with the next_offset from that response.
offset.title: Offset

name: iso20022_code_sets

active_values.description: Number of current values in the code set
active_values.title: Active Values

concept.description: Short code set name, e.g. BalanceType
concept.title: Concept

concept_description.description: AI-generated description of the code set
concept_description.title: Concept Description

deactivated_in.description: Navigator data load (quarter) in which the code set was marked deactivated; absent if current
deactivated_in.title: Deactivated In

deactivated_values.description: Number of values marked deactivated; absent if none
deactivated_values.title: Deactivated Values

message_count.description: Number of messages in used_in_messages (all variants). Use it instead of counting the list; absent when the requested code is not in the set
message_count.title: Message Count

name.description: Full ISO name of the code set, e.g. ExternalBalanceType1Code
name.title: Name

navigator_group.description: The Navigator's own grouping of code sets (13 groups); not an ISO classification
navigator_group.title: Navigator Group

complete.description: True when this page ends the list
complete.title: Complete

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page; absent when complete
next_offset.title: Next Offset

offset.description: Row number this page starts at (0 = first row)
offset.title: Offset

Provenance.description: Where the data comes from [3.6]. Each tool supplies its own `scope`.

data_baseline.description: Quarter of the Navigator's baseline data load, e.g. 4Q2025: data reflects that load unless stated otherwise. This is when data was added to the Navigator, not an ISO 20022 publication.
data_baseline.title: Data Baseline

Provenance.title: Provenance

code_set.description: Attributes of the code set (input_kind code_set)

code_sets.description: input_kind message: the code sets the message uses, pipe-delimited, one row per line. First line is the header: concept|navigator_group|code_count. code_count is the number of current values.
code_sets.title: Code Sets

input.description: The identifier as interpreted by the server: the code set's short name, the ISO 20022 message, or the code
input.title: Input

iso20022_deactivated_in.description: Navigator data load (quarter) in which the input message was marked deactivated; absent if current
iso20022_deactivated_in.title: Iso20022 Deactivated In

iso20022_message_name.description: Name of the ISO 20022 message, when the input is one
iso20022_message_name.title: Iso20022 Message Name

matches.description: input_kind code: every code set containing the code, pipe-delimited, one row per line. First line is the header: concept|code|name|description|deactivated_in.
matches.title: Matches

notes.description: Caveats to pass on to the user
notes.title: Notes

page.description: Paging of the pipe-delimited list. Continue with next_offset until complete is true.

used_in_messages.description: input_kind code_set: IDs of the messages (all variants) that use this code set. Complete on every page.
used_in_messages.title: Used In Messages

values.description: input_kind code_set: the values, pipe-delimited, one row per line. First line is the header: code|name|description|deactivated_in. deactivated_in is empty for current values.
values.title: Values

title: ISO 20022 code sets
